entries.title: LibreOffice Headless Fallback for Legacy Office Formats
entries.claim_source: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — PDF and Office Document Text Extraction section
entries.expected: Spawn soffice --headless to convert legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt to text in a sandboxed subprocess (posix_spawn, restricted OS user, 30 s timeout)
entries.observed: Implemented: extractLegacyViaLibreOffice() uses posix_spawn with POSIX_SPAWN_RESETIDS, POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP, POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF; 30 s SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation; RAII temp-dir cleanup; HOME restricted to tmp dir
evidence: src/content/office_processor.cpp: posix_spawn, posix_spawnattr_setflags, posix_spawn_file_actions used at lines 887–912
entries.impact: Legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt files are now extracted via soffice headless
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): implement LibreOffice headless fallback in office_processor.cpp for legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt

entries.title: MimeDetector-Triggered OCR via ContentPolicy
entries.expected: MimeDetector triggers OCR for image/png, image/jpeg, image/tiff when ContentPolicy::ocrEnabled() == true for the collection
entries.observed: Implemented: MimeDetector::shouldTriggerOcr() checks policy_.ocrEnabled() and returns true for image/png, image/jpeg, image/tiff; ValidationResult::ocr_recommended is populated
entries.impact: OCR is automatically triggered during ingestion when collection policy enables it
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): add ContentPolicy::ocrEnabled() and wire OCR trigger in MimeDetector

entries.title: OCR Pre-Processing: DPI Rescaling to 300 DPI
entries.expected: Rescale images to 300 DPI before OCR if metadata indicates lower resolution; apply adaptive binarisation via Leptonica
entries.observed: Implemented: OcrProcessor::Config has target_dpi=300, enable_dpi_rescaling=true, enable_adaptive_binarization=true. runTesseract() uses pixGetXRes/pixGetYRes for DPI detection, pixScale for upscaling, pixConvertTo8+pixSauvolaBinarize(whsize=15, k=0.35) for binarisation. Metadata fields ocr_input_dpi, ocr_rescaled, ocr_binarized populated in ExtractionResult::metadata
evidence: src/content/ocr_processor.cpp:171 — DPI detection and pixScale upscaling
entries.impact: OCR quality on low-resolution scans is improved; pre-processing normalisation applied automatically
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): add 300-DPI rescaling and adaptive binarisation in ocr_processor.cpp

entries.title: OCR Language Pack Path Not Constrained to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/
entries.expected: Language packs loaded from config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/; default eng; configurable per-collection
entries.observed: Implemented: runTesseract() calls ConfigPathResolver::tryResolve("config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang") when config_.data_dir is empty; resolved path used as tessdata dir; falls back to Tesseract auto-detect when directory does not exist
entries.impact: Consistent deployment; operators no longer need to manually configure the tessdata path
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): default ocr_processor data_dir to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/ via ConfigPathResolver

entries.title: Streaming Ingestion Back-Pressure Not Implemented
entries.expected: ingestStream() blocks the caller when the worker queue depth exceeds config_.max_queue_depth; returns a std::future<ContentId> for async callers
entries.observed: Implemented: submitStream() blocks via std::condition_variable::wait when job_queue_.size() >= config_.max_queue_depth; ingestStream() returns std::future<std::string>; backpressure_cv_ notified on dequeue and shutdown
entries.impact: Queue depth is respected under load; callers are throttled and no unbounded growth occurs
entries.issue_title_suggestion: feat(content): implement back-pressure in async_ingestion_worker.cpp for ingestStream()

entries.title: Zip-Bomb Protection in archive_processor.cpp [RESOLVED]
entries.expected: content_security.cpp scans all uploaded archives for zip-bomb patterns; enforce max decompressed-to-compressed ratio of 100× and max extracted file count of 1,000
entries.observed: ContentSecurityManager::checkZipBomb() implemented in content_security.h/.cpp (ratio 100×, max 1 000 entries). ArchiveProcessor::process() calls it after validateArchive() and before extraction. Item marked [x] in FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md and ROADMAP.md.
evidence: src/content/content_security.cpp: ContentSecurityManager::checkZipBomb() enforces ratio>100x => CONTENT_MALWARE_DETECTED, file_count>1000 => CONTENT_SIZE_EXCEEDED
tests/test_content_security.cpp: 20 ZipBombProtectionTest cases cover all enforcement paths
entries.impact: Maliciously crafted ZIP/tar archives could exhaust memory or disk during extraction
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(content/security): add zip-bomb protection in archive_processor.cpp via content_security.cpp

entries.title: LibreOffice Subprocess Must Use posix_spawn with Restricted User
entries.expected: LibreOffice headless subprocess runs under a restricted OS user with no write access to ThemisDB data dir; uses posix_spawn instead of system()
entries.observed: Implemented as part of CON-001: posix_spawn with POSIX_SPAWN_RESETIDS (drops SUID bits), POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP (new process group), POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF (reset signal handlers); HOME set to temp dir so soffice cannot modify user home dir
entries.impact: LibreOffice subprocess is sandboxed; a malicious document cannot compromise the ThemisDB data directory
entries.issue_title_suggestion: fix(content/security): ensure LibreOffice subprocess in office_processor.cpp uses posix_spawn with restricted user
